parsed.rationale: Both `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeMessage` (line 28 in `HLSPlayerMessages.swift`) and `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeMessage` (line 29 in `RadioPlayerMessages.swift`) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package, indicating their bodies are identical. Because both types are rate-change message types in the same package with no restraint markers (all context flags false), the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `PlayerMessage`) within the `Playback` package and provide a default implementation of `makeMessage` in a protocol extension, eliminating the redundant per-type bodies. Both conformer files can then drop their individual implementations.
